X-energy (x-energy.com), Rockville, MD; Xe-100 high-temperature gas-cooled SMRs and TRISO-X fuel. Planned SPAC with Ares Acquisition Corp terminated Oct 2023; Series C finalized at $235M (Dec 2023, incl. $80M added by founder Kam Ghaffarian and Ares).
